Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

DSpark / spec-v2 decode on HIP waits on the host every step to read the accept lengths. This removes that sync so the next step can be scheduled while the GPU is still busy. HIP only; other platforms are unchanged. Independent of the monokernel PRs that follow (part 1 of 4).

## Modifications

- Skip the per-step host read of the accept lengths in the overlap scheduler when no attention backend needs CPU sequence lengths (HIP only).
- Fold the simulated accept / bonus into the verify epilogue so it stays inside the graph (`SGLANG_DSPARK_SIMULATE_FOLD`, default on; HIP only, and only with `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN` set).

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K 1319: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 DSpark 0.906; DeepSeek-V4-Pro TP8 EAGLE 0.951 before / 0.948 after.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 DSpark decode, c1 TPOT: -6.8% without the per-step sync, a further -1% to -3% with the fold.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro TP8 EAGLE, 8k TPOT c1 / c4: -0.8% / -1.2% (within run-to-run noise; no regression).

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -60,6 +60,99 @@ def _simulated_bonus_select_kernel(
     )
 
 
+@triton.jit
+def _simulated_bonus_row_partial_kernel(
+    logits_ptr,
+    logits_stride,
+    temperatures_ptr,
+    correct_len_ptr,
+    seed_ptr,
+    part_val_ptr,
+    part_idx_ptr,
+    vocab,
+    ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    NSPLIT: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0)
+    split = tl.program_id(1)
+    row = req * ROWS + tl.load(correct_len_ptr + req)
+    t = tl.load(temperatures_ptr + req).to(tl.float32)
+    offs = split * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < vocab
+    x = tl.load(
+        logits_ptr + row.to(tl.int64) * logits_stride + offs,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=float("-inf"),
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    seed = tl.load(seed_ptr)
+    u = tl.rand(seed, req * vocab + offs)
+    noisy = x / tl.maximum(t, 1e-5) - tl.log(-tl.log(u))
+    v = tl.where(mask, tl.where(t > 0.0, noisy, x), float("-inf"))
+    top = tl.max(v, axis=0)
+    idx = tl.min(tl.where(v == top, offs, vocab), axis=0)
+    tl.store(part_val_ptr + req * NSPLIT + split, top)
+    tl.store(part_idx_ptr + req * NSPLIT + split, idx)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _simulated_bonus_row_select_kernel(
+    part_val_ptr,
+    part_idx_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    vocab,
+    NSPLIT: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0)
+    s = tl.arange(0, NSPLIT)
+    val = tl.load(part_val_ptr + req * NSPLIT + s)
+    idx = tl.load(part_idx_ptr + req * NSPLIT + s)
+    top = tl.max(val, axis=0)
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + req, tl.min(tl.where(val == top, idx, vocab), axis=0).to(tl.int64)
+    )
+
+
+def simulated_bonus_sample_graph(
+    *,
+    target_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    correct_len: torch.Tensor,
+    temperatures: torch.Tensor,
+    seed: torch.Tensor,
+    bs: int,
+    rows_per_request: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Graph-safe variant of simulated_bonus_sample: seed ([1] int) and per-request
+    temperatures ([bs] float; <= 0 means argmax) are read from device buffers, and
+    only the row at ``correct_len`` is sampled. [bs] int64."""
+    assert target_logits.stride(1) == 1
+    device = target_logits.device
+    vocab = target_logits.shape[1]
+    block = 4096
+    nsplit = triton.next_power_of_2(triton.cdiv(vocab, block))
+    part_val = torch.empty((bs, nsplit), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    part_idx = torch.empty((bs, nsplit), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    _simulated_bonus_row_partial_kernel[(bs, nsplit)](
+        target_logits,
+        target_logits.stride(0),
+        temperatures,
+        correct_len.contiguous(),
+        seed,
+        part_val,
+        part_idx,
+        vocab,
+        ROWS=rows_per_request,
+        NSPLIT=nsplit,
+        BLOCK=block,
+        num_warps=8,
+    )
+    out = torch.empty((bs,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    _simulated_bonus_row_select_kernel[(bs,)](
+        part_val, part_idx, out, vocab, NSPLIT=nsplit
+    )
+    return out
+
+

     *,
     target_logits: torch.Tensor,
